links.outcome: LLM protocol accuracy versus radiologists on 300 cases with expert consensus
links.effect: LLM overall accuracy 80% versus 83% for radiologists, no significant difference (p = 0.263); LLM exceeded radiologists for some challenging categories.
links.quote: On 300 independent cases with expert consensus, the LLM reached an overall accuracy of 80% versus 83% for radiologists, with no significant difference (p = 0.263).

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation comparing an LLM-derived embedding model to radiologists on CT protocol selection, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
